emotional_tone: Regal, deeply romantic, sincere, highly immersive, elegant, nostalgic.

typography.notes: Headings must never use Inter or generic sans. Apply 'tracking-tighter' on large headings. Script font used sparingly for emotional quotes or signatures.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol (Tetris mode) for galleries. Generous gap-8 to gap-12.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Center-aligned for hero and romantic quotes. Left-aligned for timeline and long-form apologies to ensure readability.

surface_strategies.glassmorphism: Used for Password Lock, Love Timer, and floating nav. bg-[#1A0A2E]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-[#FFD700]/20 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(75,0,130,0.3)].
surface_strategies.borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.15) for cards. Avoid thick solid borders.
surface_strategies.shadows: Ambient glows using colored shadows, e.g., shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,215,0,0.1)].

hero_background.description: Royal palace interior. Must be overlaid with bg-[#0B0014]/70 to ensure text readability.

crown_element.description: Gold crown to be clipped or blended at the top of the hero section.

wax_seal.description: Vintage wax seal parchment for the Love Letter section.

celebration_roses.description: Red roses for the Yes Celebration and Forever section background.

photo_album_placeholders.description: Use as a fallback/placeholder in the Photo Album masonry grid. Provide instructions in UI for the user to swap these.

password_lock.description: Full screen overlay. Glassmorphism card in center. Input for calendar date.
password_lock.visuals: Dark blurred background. Input styled with bottom border only (no box), glowing gold on focus.

hero.description: Full viewport height. Background image (palace) heavily darkened.
hero.visuals: Animated crown graphic. Typography in Cormorant Garamond. Floating hearts and sparkles via framer-motion or TSParticles.

love_timer.description: Displays Years, Months, Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds.
love_timer.visuals: Grid layout (cols-3 or cols-6). Each number in a glassmorphic box with gold text and ivory label.

apology_story.description: 5 staggered reveal cards outlining the apology.
apology_story.visuals: Asymmetric scrolling list. Cards overlap slightly. Dark purple surface with thin gold borders.

memory_timeline.visuals: Central gold line (`w-px bg-[#FFD700]/50`). Nodes are glowing gold dots. Cards alternating sides. 'Magical diary pages' aesthetic using ivory text on dark surfaces.

photo_album.description: Masonry grid of photos with polaroid frames.
photo_album.visuals: Images have `border-4 border-white/10` and subtle tilt. Lightbox opening on click.

love_letter.description: Parchment texture background with wax seal.
love_letter.visuals: Uses the wax seal image. Text is styled like handwriting (Great Vibes script). Gold glowing frame around the container.

reasons_i_love_you.visuals: CSS or Framer Motion 3D rotateY on hover. Front shows a number/icon, back shows the reason.

special_moments.visuals: 2x2 or bento grid. Each card has heart animations on hover. Background images with dark overlays.

forgiveness_meter.visuals: Fills up on scroll or click. Gradient from Primary Purple to Accent Gold. Glow effect.

final_question.visuals: Massive typography. 'YES' button pulses and grows on hover. 'NO' button runs away (chase mechanic: changes absolute position on hover).

celebration_screen.visuals: Fullscreen overlay. Confetti animation, floating roses, fireworks effect. 'Thank You' message.

motion_and_interactions.scrolling: Use 'lenis' library for momentum scrolling. It adds weight and premium feel.
motion_and_interactions.particles: Use 'tsparticles' (or react-tsparticles) for moving mist, floating hearts, and star sparkles across the entire background.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift `-translate-y-2` with an increased gold shadow. Text elements shift slightly.
motion_and_interactions.reveal: Use framer-motion `whileInView` for fade-up and subtle scale-in of sections as they enter the viewport.

icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight) for luxury, elegant iconography (hearts, crowns, stars).
instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark Theme + Luxury Archetype 5. No stark white backgrounds anywhere.
Install and use `framer-motion`, `lenis`, and `tsparticles` (or `react-tsparticles`) for the magical/living background and scroll effects.
Install Google Fonts 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Outfit', and 'Great Vibes' via standard CSS imports in index.css.
Implement the 'NO' button chase mechanic using standard React state (x, y coordinates) updated `onMouseEnter`.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
Never use pure black (#000000). Use the provided background.base (#0B0014).
For the Love Letter, use the parchment image URL provided, apply a heavy vignette/gradient to blend it into the dark background.
Create a clean code structure keeping the single-page scroll highly modular (e.g., HeroSection.jsx, TimelineSection.jsx).
Add code comments explaining to the user exactly where and how to replace the image placeholder URLs with their own real photos.
